title: First Repeated Value

statement.markdown:
Given an array of integers `nums`, return the first value whose **second** appearance occurs earliest in the array. If no value repeats, return `-1`.

In other words: scanning left to right, which value is the first one you see for the second time?

tests.note: later first-appearance can still repeat first

hints: You need to know, for the current value, whether it has appeared before. What structure answers that in O(1)?
Keep a set of everything seen so far; the first value already in the set when you reach it is the answer.
solutionExplanation: Scan once, keeping a hash set of values already seen. The moment the current value is in the set, that's the earliest second appearance — return it. Falling off the loop means no repeats. Time O(n), space O(n).
